description: [roadmap S3.6b] No pinned checkpoint frame holds the golfer list (drawEmployeeViewPanel's list mode). The five scenarios whose runs reach the function (cov_a_play, cov_b_holes18, cov_r_s2_screens, ui_tour, ui_tour_v; the census reason is cumulative, so their later rows carried it) show the golfer action panel, the scoreboard, the build palettes, the employee detail panel or an S2 screen at every checkpoint (contact sheets of the references, log/roadmap/S3/6b_sheet_refs.py). The list's drawing is judged by the emulator call oracle instead: the original function under Unicorn on 240 varied segment start images gives the same sequence of drawing calls (callee, image, position, colour, text) as the port's body in every case (port/test/test_gfx_hud.py test_panel_calls_equal_the_original, SG_EMU_ORACLE=1; 38 of 41 jcc sites both sides, the rest in U-1384); the pixels of the calls it makes are the bodies other families own (Surface_drawScaled, Image_draw, drawText4049d0, fillWindowRect, Surface_stretchBlit).
needed: A pinned checkpoint with the golfer list open (a scenario step that clicks the golfers button and waits a frame).

description: [roadmap S3.6b] The employee detail panel's frame oracle covers only its no-selection, no-employee branch: ui_tour / ui_tour_v `people` (bottom panel 0 of 59,956 opaque px differ) and cov_r_s2_screens `hire` (under S2's hire dialog, no opaque panel pixel). The selection branch (the frame of the selected slot, the three action buttons with their hover images, the text block: name, hire date, wage, role, the number of word +0x16), the scroll arrows and the hire / full images are judged only by the emulator call oracle (239 of 240 cases equal, 1 case the original faults in pickGolferName on a varied record; 37 of 39 jcc sites both sides).

description: [roadmap S3.6b] Two calls of the detail panel go to bodies this tree does not hold, and are reported: the listed employees' animated figures (cellAt + addSprite, `addSprite: the sprite queue (drawEmployeeDetailPanel's employees)`, S3.5's scene family) and the circle around the selected employee on the course (drawCircle 0x00407c60, 25 lineTo segments: `drawCircle: ...`, the overlay lines of S3.8). description: [roadmap S3.6b] The HUD opaque-pixel measure of S3.6 assumed a terrain-less frame. Since S3.2 the terrain is drawn into the root every frame, opaquely and within G2 (not pixel-exact), so it counts as opaque in both background fills: on the rebased tree ui_tour's `game` row had 27,844 bad bottom-panel px and every HUD frame test of test_gfx_hud.py failed (log/roadmap/S3/6b_pytest_hud_pre.log, 16 of 23). The gate (log/roadmap/S3/6b_hudgate.py) and the tests' fill runs now take framegate --no-live (LiveTerrain not attached), which reproduces S3.6's measure. A combined measure (HUD exact, terrain under G2) is the section gate's (S3.9).
needed: S3.9's census rule for frames holding both.
